findings.description: Publisher verifies digest, producer and semantic source pins, previous prefix digest and target anchor, but does not bind target_graph, target_graph_length or earliest_served_timestamp to the candidate. prepare produces correct values; a modified sidecar supplied directly to publish may make false graph/serving-date claims.
findings.recommendation: Validate candidate-derived sidecar fields at publication and negative-test edited fields. Validate strict prefix/cursor ranges and appended-edge order/shape; do not imply manifest itself proves chain truth.
findings.status: open at this exact inspected source

limits: This was a source inspection, not execution, a chain proof, maximum-state capacity or lifetime archive/provider operating qualification.
A reviewed prefix digest still represents explicit operator trust in prior evidence; no complete-log cryptographic proof is created.
Future adoption requires independent producer/candidate review and explicit service configuration; this review grants no approval.
reviewed_properties: Explicit schema2 original or strictly shorter schema3 input; existing strict loaders and exact current source pins retained.
Pure truncated decoder views and build-local checkpoint adapter; installed engine configuration is not mutated.
Complete target graph authentication including appended receipt/state-root edges, original identity, strict operating input cursor and all-peer native/fixed-ZZZ pair.
Existing exact replay, current-owner claims/conversions, phase restoration and strict standard3 output admission reused without semantic edits.
Whole outer work budget, artifact/grammar/event/predecessor limits, full-day serving gate and raw-retention requirement remain.
No automatic checkpoint adoption, signature, deployment, service restart, raw pruning or financial authority change.
Separate producer sidecar pins both new producer files; semantic source identities are not overridden or relabelled.
Exclusive review-first publication documents partial-output failure and never overwrites existing outputs.
